thread:
Jordan T: Candidate for SDE2 (EMEA) accepted role verbally but got a local market counter. Asking for geo-parity top-up + an earlier start (Apr 1). Need quick route for exception.
Anya (People Ops): paste redacted numbers pls
Jordan T: Offer: base €110k + 8% bonus, band cap €118k. Candidate counter: €124k and wants to start Apr 1 vs Apr 20. They're relocating, asking to lock relocation mode and start date.
Carlos (Hiring): this hire unblocks a client pilot. We can fund a temporary top-up for 60 days to match counter while comp reviews. Prefer lump sign-on to avoid payroll complexity.
Mei (Comp): Policy: temporary economic parity possible as either a one-off sign-on or a defined provisional uplift. Required: Comp approval + VP Eng + Finance. Clawback language needed if final band decision doesn't support uplift. Recommend sign-on <= €6k or provisional monthly top-up <= €3k/mo max 60 days.
FinBot: Required approvers identified: comp@, vp-engr@, finance@. Suggested path: one-time sign-on payable on first payroll, include 6-month retention clawback.
Anya (People Ops): draft language proposal: keep base €110k, add one-time relocation/top-up €6,000 payable on first payroll if candidate starts by 2026-04-01; clause: final comp review complete by 2026-06-01, repay pro rata if they leave within 6 months. Sending to Legal + Comp.
Jordan T: I can justify to VP — this is on critical path. Will attach pilot timeline and candidate relocation timeline.
Mei (Comp): I'll prepare the exception memo and route to VP Eng + Finance. If VP approves, Comp will sign off and People Ops will issue updated offer. Need hiring manager confirmation they will fund sign-on.
Carlos (Hiring): confirmed, budget approved.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Action: one-time sign-on + start date change. Approvals required: comp, VP Eng, Finance. Estimated routing time: 24-48h. Candidate deadline?"
Jordan T: Candidate needs answer by EOD tomorrow for moving housing.
Anya (People Ops): noted. I'll mark as expedited and log in exceptions tracker with redacted docs. Will communicate "provisional approval pending VP" language to candidate so they can start relocation planning.
Mei (Comp): tagging @VP Eng for urgent review. Also including suggested clawback wording for Legal.
FinBot: Finance flagged payroll timing dependency — need payroll calendar alignment to pay in first run after start. People Ops to confirm date.
Anya (People Ops): will coordinate payroll date. Thanks team — I'll update candidate once VP responds. :white_check_mark:
